$comment: A quest to try a challenge in the game with, Adam's to change: Brother Anselm challenges the house to a debate in the square. Won, the road goes straight to his blessing, the cheaper road; lost, the house first pays a penance in wealth. A challenge node puts a challenge to the house: its kind, one of the challenges' kinds; who stands against it, a name and the colour their side is shown in; and the slices they bring, written as the challenges page writes a slice, which the player does not see before it starts. It leads then to one node when it is won and another when it is lost, a draw counting as lost. The rest as the abbot's quest writes it. Every word and number a placeholder. Written on 2026-10-23; the debug panel's Quests section offers it, and /admin/inspect-quests shows and edits it. See decision records 0096 and 0107, amended, and docs/plans/challenges-in-the-game.md.
title: The debate in the square
